integrity: An exact universal proof and a standalone Python standard-library checker are provided; numerical experiments are corroborative only. Same-model review performed; independent mathematical and originality audit not performed.
limitations: Exactly five equally spaced equal-amplitude and equal-phase pure tones, one Gaussian window, all positive bandwidth-gap parameters; classifies the full continuous STFT zero set but not ridges, stability or generic multitone inputs. One principal 2026 source was not available in full text for literature-priority comparison.
title: Two sharp zero-bifurcation scales for a five-tone Gaussian spectrogram
